```{r}
wd <- getwd()
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```


```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/DMPs_10.000.csv')
DMPs_10.000 <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

# PCA
```{r}
# subsetting DMPs_10.000 in die ersten 1000
DMPs_1000 <- DMPs_10.000[1:1000,]
```

```{r}
# Subset der BRCA Methylierungsdaten
BRCA_data_DMP_1000 <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original)%in%rownames(DMPs_1000),]
```

```{r}
#Subset des Annotation Dataframes mit dem Type
#drop=FALSE behält die Dimensionen
tissue_types <- BRCA_sample_sheet[,7, drop=FALSE]
```

## PCA der Patienten
```{r}
pca_patients_1000_sigCpGs <- prcomp(t(BRCA_data_DMP_1000))
```

```{r}
BRCA_sample_sheet$Type <- as.factor(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type)
unique_types <- unique(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type)
colors = c('red','blue') #Farben auswählen
ts = color[BRCA_sample_sheet$Type] #Farben den Klassifizierungen zuordnen
```

```{r}
pdf("PCA_patients_1000_sig_Cpgs.pdf")
plot(pca_patients_1000_sigCpGs$x[,1],
    pca_patients_1000_sigCpGs$x[,2],
    xlab='PC1',
    ylab='PC2',
    col= ts,
    pch=19)
legend("bottomleft", legend = unique_types, pch = 19, col=colors)
dev.off()

```
